name: SA Multimicrocloud
summary: MultiMicroCloud SA is a French-based software developer, specializing in creating Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that leverage both cloud and mobile technologies. Their platforms are primarily designed for the hotel and restaurant industry, streamlining various aspects of business management, particularly reservation and booking processes. What sets their offering apart is a distinctive unified solution that integrates three essential hospitality functions: a Property Management System (PMS) for reservation and billing, a multi-channel Booking Engine for broad distribution, and a Yield management system for strategic decision support.
